events.title: Hexzen demo release date
events.summary: Hi everyone,We're excited to announce that the Hexzen demo launches on August 4, in all 15 planned languages.The demo packs more than an hour of content:- The first part of the campaign, including the full tutorial and the first boss- The daily puzzle, for anyone who wants moreWe hope you enjoy it!See you next week, and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to stay in the loop on future news!

events.title: Behind the scenes of Hexzen's 15 languages
events.summary: Hexzen speaks English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Finnish, Czech, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Arabic. Even without dialogue on the board, there are still the menus, the settings, the help, the level and campaign editors, and above all the story content. People sometimes think Hexzen has no story; it does. Its official campaign, The Echo of the Runes, has a quiet story running through it: five Major Runes to awaken,
